# Case 1: simple knnDist, k=3
{"k":3,"knnDist":[[0.0, 0.5, 1.0],[0.0, 0.2, 0.8],[0.0, 0.0, 0.4]]}
@ Expected rho is min positive distance in each row
{"rho":[0.5,0.2,0.4]}

# Case 2: one row all zeros, one row positive
{"k":3,"knnDist":[[0,0,0],[0,2,3]]}
@ Row 0 has no positive distances → rho=0; row 1 min positive is 2
{"rho":[0,2]}

# Case 3: mixed ordering with a zero
{"k":4,"knnDist":[[0.3,0.1,0.2,0.5],[1.0,0.0,0.7,0.9]]}
@ Row 0 min positive is 0.1; row 1 min positive is 0.7
{"rho":[0.1,0.7]}

# Case 4: simple two-row case
{"k":2,"knnDist":[[0.2,0.4],[0.5,0.6]]}
@ Row 0 rho=0.2; row 1 rho=0.5
{"rho":[0.2,0.5]}

# Case 5: negative distances (ignored) and zeros
{"k":3,"knnDist":[[-1.0,0.5,0.0],[-0.1,-0.2,-0.3]]}
@ Row 0 rho=0.5; row 1 has no positive distances → rho=0
{"rho":[0.5,0]}
